summary: Research premium fresh-food e-commerce design, parallax, and food photography to produce a build-ready design brief

result.brief: Single hero image exists. The brief targets the full ~30-image set to be generated. I have everything I need. Here is the synthesized brief. --- # eSegar Design Brief — "Always Segar" **Premium Fresh Halal Chicken Delivery · Melaka · Elevated Warm** Direction: cream-warm editorial butcher craft with a dark cinematic hero. Appetite-forward, freshness-proven, halal-trusted, fast for e-commerce. Decisions below are final. --- ## 1. ART DIRECTION — North Star eSegar looks like a modern Melaka butcher's atelier, not a supermarket aisle and not a cold delivery app. The whole site lives on warm cream butcher-paper neutrals with charcoal ink, lit by soft window light, where the only saturated colors are the natural blush of fresh chicken, one appetite ember-red for action, and a single deep halal-green for trust. We borrow the wet-market's two non-negotiables (visible, dated freshness and a human relationship) and the modern store's hygiene and convenience, then wrap the entry in one cinematic dark hero so the first impression is appetite and craft, before the page opens into bright, fast, easy-to-shop cream. Restraint is the premium signal: deep stillness, generous negative space, one focal subject per view, motion you feel but cannot point to. --- ## 2. COLOR SYSTEM Cream base, charcoal ink, green as the trust anchor, ember-red + warm-amber as appetite accents only. Two surfaces: the bright commerce body and the dark cinematic moments (hero, final CTA). | Token | Hex | Role | Usage rule | |---|---|---|---| | `--cream` | `#FAF4E8` | Page background (body) | Default canvas everywhere outside dark sections. Never pure white. | | `--cream-deep` | `#F3EAD7` | Alt section band | Alternate section backgrounds for rhythm; process / why-us bands. | | `--surface` | `#FFFDF8` | Cards, raised surfaces | Product cards, FAQ panels. Warm off-white, sits just above cream. | | `--ink` | `#1A1714` | Headlines + body text | Warm near-black. All primary type. Never gray-on-gray. | | `--ink-soft` | `#6B6256` | Secondary text | Origin lines, captions, meta, per-kg rates. | | `--ember` | `#C8362F` | PRIMARY appetite-red | CTAs (Order, Add to cart), price, promo flags, "Disembelih hari ini" stamp. Accent only — never a large fill in the light body. | | `--ember-deep` | `#A52A23` | Ember hover/press | Button hover, pressed states. | | `--amber` | `#E8843C` | Warm secondary accent | Freshness cues, icon strokes, hover glows, cooking-method icons. Always paired with cream. | | `--halal-green` | `#1E7A4D` | Trust primary | Halal section, trust badges, "Fresh today" tags, green icon strokes. Distinct from JAKIM's official mark. | | `--halal-green-deep` | `#14723E` | Green emphasis | Trust headlines, badge borders. | | `--gold` | `#B8893C` | Luxe hairline accent | Thin dividers / premium-line badge only. Use sparingly; no metallic fills. | | **Dark mode (hero + final CTA)** | | | | | `--charcoal` | `#0E0F0D` | Hero/CTA base | Warm near-black backdrop for cinematic sections only. | | `--charcoal-2` | `#16181 4` → use `#161814` | Dark surface | Glass card base over charcoal. | | `--warm-white` | `#F4F1EA` | Text on dark | Hero headline + dark-section text. | | `--glow-warm` | `#E8843C` @ low alpha | Hero key glow | Radial glow behind hero subject; 20–35% alpha. | **Hard rules** - Red never dominates: ember is reserved for action + price + the freshness stamp. Red-heavy reads fast-food and kills premium. - Green carries double duty (halal for Muslim buyers, hygiene/clean for everyone). Keep brand green visually distinct from the official JAKIM logo; never recolor or redraw that logo. - Meat color comes from photography, never from UI fills. - Pure `#FFFFFF` is banned as a background. Pure black is banned as a large fill. --- ## 3. TYPOGRAPHY Keep the warm geometric body, upgrade the display to an editorial high-contrast serif for heritage + appetite. Two families, all Google Fonts. | Role | Typeface | Why | |---|---|---| | Display / hero / product names | **Fraunces** (serif, high optical contrast, "Soft" + high-contrast axis) | Editorial heritage warmth, appetite signal, gives instant premium over a grotesque. Use the display optical size for the hero. | | UI / body / prices / badges | **Nunito** (keep) | Friendly rounded geometric sans, trustworthy, excellent at small sizes, already in the stack. | | Eyebrows / kickers / micro-labels | **Nunito** (uppercase, tracked) | Tiny tracked labels for "HALAL CERTIFIED · DELIVERED FRESH DAILY". | > Bricolage Grotesque is dropped. Fraunces replaces it as the display face: it carries the elevated-warm editorial tone better and pairs cleanly with Nunito. If a second weight of brand personality is wanted in section eyebrows, set Nunito 800 uppercase tracked +0.12em. **Type scale** (clamp, fluid; 1.25 major-third on mobile → looser on desktop) | Token | Size (clamp) | Font / weight | Use | |---|---|---|---| | `display` | `clamp(56px, 9vw, 168px)` | Fraunces 600, tracking −0.02em | Hero "ALWAYS SEGAR" | | `h1` | `clamp(40px, 5.5vw, 76px)` | Fraunces 600 | Section openers | | `h2` | `clamp(30px, 3.5vw, 48px)` | Fraunces 600 | Sub-sections | | `h3` | `clamp(22px, 2vw, 28px)` | Fraunces 600 | Product names, card titles | | `lead` | `clamp(18px, 1.6vw, 22px)` | Nunito 600 | Intro paragraphs, subcopy | | `body` | `17px / 1.65` | Nunito 400 | Default text | | `small` | `15px` | Nunito 600 | Origin lines, per-kg, meta | | `eyebrow` | `13px`, tracking +0.14em, uppercase | Nunito 800 | Kickers, badges | | `price` | `clamp(20px, 2vw, 26px)` | Nunito 800, color `--ember` | Card price | **Big editorial heading treatment** - Hero headline: Fraunces 600, negative tracking, near-white on charcoal, the chicken photo occludes the leading edge of one word (layer 4 over layer 3). - Section headers: allow a one- or two-word fragment in `--ember` or `--halal-green` within an otherwise ink headline ("Always **Segar**", "Sembelih **pagi ini**") to color-anchor meaning. - Never two display weights competing in one view. One typeface does hierarchy through scale + weight, never decoration. - Numerals: Nunito tabular for prices and counters so digits don't jitter on count-up. --- ## 4. LAYOUT & SPACING **Grid** — 12-column, max content width `1240px`, gutter `24px`, outer margin `clamp(20px, 5vw, 80px)`. Hero overflows the right edge; everything else respects the grid. **Spacing scale** (8px base): `4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64 · 96 · 128`. Section vertical padding `clamp(64px, 10vw, 128px)`. Negative space is the luxury lever — when in doubt, add a step. **Section rhythm** — alternate `--cream` and `--cream-deep` bands so adjacent sections never share a background. Each section: eyebrow → headline → one-line lead → content. One focal idea per section. **Radius + shadow** — radius `16px` cards, `12px` buttons, `999px` pills. Shadows warm-tinted, never gray: `0 8px 28px rgba(40,28,16,0.10)` resting, `0 16px 40px rgba(40,28,16,0.16)` on hover. **Product card anatomy** (top → bottom, the consensus butcher spec): | Layer | Spec | |---|---| | 1 · Image | Square (1:1), product centered on marble/oak/butcher-paper, `--surface` frame. Hover crossfades to a second angle or cooked variant. | | 2 · Status badge | Top-left overlay, color-coded: `--ember` = Limited / Last batch; `--halal-green` = Fresh Today / Halal; `--ink` = Sold out. | | 3 · Quality label | Above name: "Halal Certified" · "Free Range" · "Ayam Kampung". Eyebrow style. | | 4 · Product name | Fraunces 600, bilingual dual-line (Ayam Kampung / Free-Range Kampung Chicken). | | 5 · Origin line | `--ink-soft` small: "Ladang Melaka" or "Disembelih: 26 Jun" live date. | | 6 · Cooking-method icons | Mono-line amber/green: grill · oven · skillet. Appetite + utility cue. | | 7 · Price | `--ember` 800 prominent + per-kg rate in `--ink-soft` ("RM18 · RM12/kg"). | | 8 · Add to cart | Pill, `--ember`, BM microcopy "Tambah ke troli". Triggers fly-to-cart drop-in. | White-tone card on cream page, warm shadow, hover lift `translateY(-6px)`. --- ## 5. MOTION SYSTEM Two showstoppers (cinematic hero depth + sticky product scrollytelling), one image-scale moment, trust counters, and quiet staggered reveals binding everything. Restraint is the premium signal. **Global rules (enforce)** - Animate `transform` + `opacity` only. Never `top/left/margin/background-position`, never `background-attachment: fixed`. - Parallax layer speed ratios stay **0.2–0.5**. Anything above 0.7 reads amateur. - Every reveal is **triggerOnce** (`io.unobserve` after firing). No re-animating on re-entry. - Reveals 350–500ms, easing `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`. Counters ~1200ms ease-out. Hero load eased `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, slow. - Prefer **CSS scroll-driven animations** (`animation-timeline: scroll()/view()`, runs off main thread) with a static `@supports` fallback. IntersectionObserver for discrete reveals. Never animate inside a scroll event handler. **Ordered section treatments** | # | Section | Motion | Implementation | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Sticky header | Shrink + cream solidify/blur after 80px; logo 1 → 0.85 | 1px top sentinel via IO → toggle `.scrolled`; transition `background/padding/transform` 200ms | | 2 | Hero (3-layer) | Depth parallax + mouse parallax + staggered load (full spec §6) | CSS `scroll(root)` per layer keyframing `translate3d`; static fallback. GSAP ScrollTrigger + SplitText acceptable | | 3 | Trust strip | Icons fade + slide-up, staggered 80–120ms L→R | IO `threshold:0.2`, `rootMargin:'0 0 -10% 0'`, triggerOnce; CSS `translateY(24px)→0` | | 4 | Shop grid | Staggered grid cascade by row + hover lift | One IO over grid; incremental `transition-delay` via `--i`; hover pure CSS | | 5 | Process (sticky scrollytelling) | Pinned visual crossfades through farm→6am→cold-pack→delivery as steps scroll | `position:sticky; top:20vh` on visual column; each step an IO target that crossfades pinned image + highlights active step | | 6 | Freshness image reveal | Inner `` scales 1.12 → 1.0 inside `overflow:hidden` frame | `animation-timeline: view()`, `animation-range: entry exit`; cap at 12% | | 7 | Stats | Count-up from 0 on enter | IO triggerOnce + `requestAnimationFrame` ease-out tween ~1200ms; tabular numerals | | 8 | Reviews | Quote fade-up; faint bg word drift speed 0.15 | IO reveal; bg drift via `scroll()` timeline, very low amplitude | | 9 | Final CTA (dark) | Bg warm-gradient slow parallax (0.2); headline confident fade-up; button idle pulse (motion-safe) | `scroll()` on bg; IO on content | | — | Buttons (global) | Magnetic primary CTAs: translate toward cursor max 8px within ~80px radius, spring-back on leave | Pointer-move handler, `transform: translate()`, motion-safe only; disable on touch | | — | Add-to-cart | Thumbnail flies into cart icon, scales down | Clone node → animate `transform` along arc → cart badge bumps | **prefers-reduced-motion: reduce** — wrap all motion in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`. Under reduce: all elements visible by default (`[data-reveal]{opacity:1}`), counters render final value instantly, zero parallax/transforms, hero loads static. **Mobile (< 768px)** — kill all layer parallax, sticky pins, magnetic buttons, mouse parallax. Keep: simple fade/slide reveals, counters, hero load-in stagger, grain + vignette. Process scrollytelling converts to stacked image-above-text cards. Mobile-first: design these layouts first. --- ## 6. CINEMATIC HERO SPEC (non-WebGL) Full-viewport dark cinematic entry. Stillness + one focal subject + slow eased motion = premium. Pure CSS + GSAP, no WebGL. **Composition** — `100vh` (min 720px), 12-col. Headline cols 1–6, vertically centered. Hero chicken bleeds from the right edge into cols 6–12, off-center lower-right. Visual-weight triangle: subject (lower-right) / headline (center-left) / scroll cue (bottom-center). Generous left + top margin. **Anchor zones** — top-left: wordmark + small confident halal mark. Center-left: eyebrow → display headline → one-line subcopy → single CTA. Right/bleeding: hero photo as star. Bottom-center: scroll cue. Floating: max 2 stat cards. **Layer stack (back → front)** | Z | Layer | Content | Scroll speed | |---|---|---|---| | 0 | Atmosphere base | `--charcoal` backdrop + warm radial glow behind subject | fixed | | 1 | Background plate | Soft-focus market/kitchen bokeh, heavy vignette | 0.15 | | 2 | Light/glow | Warm bloom top-right, faint volumetric streak | 0.2 | | 3 | Oversized headline | "ALWAYS SEGAR" knockout, sits *behind* the chicken's leading edge | 0.4 | | 4 | Hero subject | Cut-out chicken overlapping the headline, soft real shadow | 0.6 | | 5 | Floating cards | Freshness stat + halal badge, slight mouse tilt | 0.8 | | 6 | Grain + vignette | Film-grain overlay 6–10% `mix-blend-mode:overlay` + edge vignette | fixed | The subject overlapping the headline is the single highest-impact depth trick. **Type** — Headline "ALWAYS SEGAR" Fraunces 600, `clamp(56px, 9vw, 168px)`, near-white on charcoal, chicken occludes one word's leading edge, very faint outer glow to lift off the dark. Eyebrow: "HALAL CERTIFIED · DELIVERED FRESH DAILY" (Nunito 800 uppercase tracked, `--halal-green`). Subcopy one line, 70% warm-white: "Fresh halal chicken, delivered the same day it's cut." CTA single pill `--ember`: "See today's fresh cuts" / BM "Lihat ayam segar hari ini". **Floating cards (max 2)** — Card 1 freshness: "Cut → doored under 4 hrs" + leaf/clock icon. Card 2 trust: halal mark + cert reference number. Glass over charcoal, faint border, soft shadow, ≤6° mouse tilt. **Motion (slow = premium)** — Load sequence ~1.6s staggered: (1) bg + glow fade 600ms; (2) headline SplitText word mask-up 700ms ease `cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`, 60ms stagger; (3) photo fade + scale 1.05→1.0 + slight upward drift 900ms; (4) cards fade + 12px rise 500ms, 120ms after photo; (5) grain + scroll cue. Ambient idle: glow pulses ±4% over 8–10s, grain animates subtly, nothing else moves. Mouse parallax: layers 3–5 shift 4–12px (closer = more), cards tilt ≤6°. No bounce, no snaps. **Atmosphere stack** — warm radial key glow behind subject · edge vignette pulling eye to center · film grain 6–10% · faint top-right bloom · cool-shadow/warm-highlight grade. **Scroll cue** — bottom-center: "SCROLL" tracked micro-label + slow downward chevron/dot loop 1.5s. **Hero photo description** — *A single whole dressed fresh chicken on dark honed slate, lower-right, 3/4 angle, single warm side/back light raking the skin for a wet specular sheen; cold-fresh cues of water droplets and a faint cold mist; near-monochrome dark scene where the chicken's natural cream-blush is the only color; shot/masked as a clean cutout with a soft real grounding shadow so it can sit over the headline; Portra/Cinestill grain, gentle vignette, warm key + cool fill.* **Mobile** — single column, headline above photo, drop one card, reduce parallax range, keep grain + vignette + slow load. Design this first. --- ## 7. PHOTOGRAPHY STYLE GUIDE One reusable recipe across all ~30 images for a single cohesive premium shoot. Paste the CORE BLOCK byte-for-byte into every prompt, swap one scene seed, append the NEGATIVE block. Only the scene line changes. ### CORE BLOCK (constant in every image) ``` Premium editorial food photography, fresh halal chicken. Soft diffused window light from the back-left as key, with a gentle warm rim light catching the edge for separation; subtle fill, deep soft shadows, no harsh highlights. Full-frame camera, 100mm macro-style lens, f/3.2, shallow depth of field, one crisp focal point, creamy falloff. Surface and props are natural materials only. Color grade warm and honest: golden highlights, slightly cool shadows, gentle film roll-off, restrained saturation, true appetizing flesh tones, never oversaturated or grey. Clean negative space, off-center composition, calm and trustworthy mood. High detail, fresh moist surface with soft natural sheen, no greasy look, photorealistic, no text, no logos. ``` ### LOCKED INGREDIENTS (never vary) - **Light:** soft back-left window key + warm rim. - **Lens:** 100mm, f/3.2, shallow DOF. - **Grade:** warm highlights, cool shadows, film roll-off, restrained saturation. - **Surfaces:** rotate only among honed white marble · pale oak board · brown butcher paper. - **Mood:** clean, fresh, trustworthy, editorial. - **Angle mix across the set:** ~60% 3/4 hero, ~40% top-down. Raw = "fresh, lightly moist, natural sheen"; prepared = "glossy buttery glaze, caramelised edges" — never confuse the two. ### NEGATIVE BLOCK (append to every image) ``` no flash, no flat front lighting, no deep focus, no plastic surfaces, no white seamless studio sweep, no oversaturation, no grey dry lifeless meat, no greasy oily look, no green or blue colour cast on meat, no clutter, no text, no watermark, no logos, no cartoon, no CGI plastic look. ``` ### PER-SHOT SCENE SEEDS (one tight line each, drop into CORE) **Hero** 1. **Hero raw whole chicken** — Whole fresh raw chicken on dark honed slate, 3/4 angle, water droplets and faint cold mist, single warm rim light on the wet skin, deep dark negative space for headline overlay, cutout-ready with soft grounding shadow. **Product — whole birds** 2. **Product whole chicken** — Whole fresh raw chicken on honed white marble, 3/4 angle, thyme and rosemary sprigs, peppercorns and salt flakes, vintage butcher knife softly out of focus behind. 3. **Ayam kampung** — Lean free-range kampung chicken on pale oak board, 3/4 angle, rustic twine and a few curry leaves, slightly leaner darker skin, warm homey light. **Raw cuts** 4. **Breast** — Two fresh raw chicken breast fillets on brown butcher paper, top-down, fresh-cut moist sheen, scattered thyme and cracked pepper. 5. **Wings** — Fresh raw chicken wings grouped in odd numbers on honed white marble, top-down, glistening fresh-cut, a lemon half to one side. 6. **Drumstick** — Three fresh raw drumsticks fanned on pale oak board, 3/4 angle, butcher twine, fresh herbs, moist natural sheen. 7. **Thigh** — Four bone-in raw chicken thighs on brown butcher paper, top-down, fresh-cut and grouped, rosemary and garlic cloves nearby. 8. **Liver** — Fresh raw chicken livers in a small pale enamel dish on honed marble, 3/4 angle, glossy deep-red sheen, a sprig of parsley, restrained and clean. 9. **Feet** — Cleaned fresh chicken feet arranged neatly on brown butcher paper, top-down, pale and fresh, ginger and spring onion to one side, tidy not cluttered. **Marinated / ready-to-cook** 10. **Glazed whole** — Marinated whole chicken with glossy buttery honey-soy glaze and golden caramelised edges on dark wood board, low 3/4 angle, strong back light catching the gloss, parsley and sesame. 11. **Spicy wings** — Raw marinated spicy chilli chicken wings, deep red sambal-style coating with a glossy buttery sheen, on pale oak board, top-down, fresh chopped chilli and lime. 12. **Herb drumsticks** — Raw herb-marinated drumsticks on a baking tray, rosemary, thyme and garlic, olive-oil sheen, top-down, warm and homey, ready to roast. 13. **Honey-soy breast** — Marinated honey-soy chicken breast fillets with glossy buttery glaze on dark wood board, 3/4 angle, sesame and spring onion, caramelised edges, strong back light. **Story / lifestyle** 14. **Farm sunrise** — Free-range chickens on green pasture at golden-hour sunrise, soft warm haze, shallow depth of field, natural wholesome documentary feel. 15. **6am clean processing** — Bright hygienic processing room at dawn, stainless surfaces, gloved hands handling fresh chicken under clean daylight, calm clinical-clean but warm-graded, documentary, trustworthy. 16. **Cold-pack with ice** — Fresh raw chicken breasts resting on crushed ice in a pale enamel tray on marble, water droplets, sprigs of dill, cold fresh clean mood, 3/4 angle. 17. **Delivery** — Insulated delivery box on a kitchen counter with vacuum-packed fresh chicken and ice packs, hands lifting a pack, soft daylight, clean and trustworthy, shallow DOF. 18. **Founder portrait** — Warm candid portrait of the founder in a clean apron in a bright market/kitchen, soft window light, holding fresh produce, confident and approachable, shallow DOF, background softly blurred. 19. **B2B refrigerated van** — A clean branded refrigerated delivery van in soft morning light outside a Melaka shoplot, 3/4 angle, crisp and trustworthy, shallow DOF, warm honest grade. 20. **Family cooking lifestyle** — Parent and child in a bright modern kitchen preparing fresh chicken together, soft window light, candid and natural, shallow DOF, background softly blurred. > Existing asset: only `assets/img/hero-chicken.webp` is present. Regenerate it from seed #1 (or treat the dark cinematic version as a new variant) and produce the remaining ~30 from these seeds so the whole catalog reads as one shoot. --- ## 8. SECTION-BY-SECTION TREATMENT | Section | What changes | Motion | |---|---|---| | **Hero** | Replace flat hero with the dark cinematic 6-layer composition (§6): cut-out chicken over knockout "ALWAYS SEGAR", warm glow, grain, vignette, 2 floating cards (freshness + halal). Single ember CTA. | Staggered ~1.6s load, 3-layer scroll parallax (0.15–0.8), mouse parallax, idle glow pulse. Mobile: stacked, static, grain kept. | | **Stats** | Convert to a trust-payload band on `--cream-deep`: "Disembelih hari ini", "Dihantar < 4 jam", "10,000+ pesanan", "0 frozen, ever". Tabular numerals, ember accents. | Count-up from 0 on enter (1200ms ease-out), labels fade-up. Reduced-motion: final values instantly. | | **Shop** | Rebuild cards to the §4 butcher anatomy: square photo, status badge, quality label, bilingual name, live-date origin, cooking-method icons, ember price + per-kg, "Tambah ke troli". Add "Build Your Box" chicken-bundle device. | Staggered grid cascade by row; hover lift `-6px` + warm shadow + image crossfade; fly-to-cart drop-in on add. | | **Process** | The signature scrollytelling: "Ladang → 6am bersih → cold-pack → pintu rumah" with a pinned visual that crossfades through farm sunrise (#14), 6am processing (#15), cold-pack/ice (#16), delivery (#17). Proves freshness + cold chain. | Sticky-pinned visual (`top:20vh`), IO step crossfades + active-step highlight, progress bar via `scroll()`. Mobile: stacked image-above-text cards, no pin. | | **Why** | "Wet-market trust, modern hygiene" value props on `--cream`. Mono-line green/amber icons, each badge paired with a concrete proof line (cold-chain "0–4°C", "Disembelih pagi ini", JAKIM cert + reference number, vacuum-sealed). BM-led copy, English premium layer. | Trust-strip staggered fade + slide-up 80–120ms L→R, triggerOnce. Optional freshness full-bleed image-scale reveal (1.12→1.0). | | **B2B** | Dedicated band for restaurants/retailers: refrigerated-van shot (#19), bulk pricing, cold-chain SLA, contract CTA "Jadi rakan niaga". `--cream-deep` background to separate from retail shop. | Image-scale reveal on the van shot; content fade-up; secondary (outline) CTA, not ember. | | **Reviews** | Melaka-family testimonials, bilingual, warm neighbourly tone with named locals. Lead with relationship + freshness proof, not adjectives. Optional press/cert logo row. | Quote fade-up; faint background word drift (speed 0.15) via `scroll()`. Quiet — copy carries it. | | **FAQ** | Accordion on `--surface` panels: halal/cert, cold chain, delivery zones (Melaka-first), cut-to-door timing, returns. Concrete, dated, honest answers. | Native-feel accordion height transition; chevron rotate; panels fade-in on section enter. No parallax. | | **CTA** | Dark cinematic close (mirror of hero palette `--charcoal`): "Order today's batch" with single ember button, halal mark + cert number reassurance line. Momentum ending. | Bg warm-gradient slow parallax (0.2), headline confident fade-up, button motion-safe idle pulse. Mobile: static bg, keep fade-up. | | **Footer** | Minimal, cream or charcoal, bilingual links, JAKIM cert + reference number, Melaka address, payment/cold-chain icons. Halal mark never placed beside non-Islamic festival imagery. | Single fade-in on enter. No parallax. | --- **Build stack:** HTML + CSS (scroll-driven animations, `@supports` fallback) + GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText) for hero/scrollytelling + IntersectionObserver for reveals/counters. No WebGL. Mobile-first. Every motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. Fonts: Fraunces + Nunito (Google Fonts). **Compliance guardrails (non-negotiable):** show the real JAKIM logo only with a valid certification and its full reference number, or stay silent; never recolor/redraw/borrow a halal mark; never place it beside non-Islamic religious/festival imagery; bilingual BM-led copy throughout; freshness shown dated and visible. Relevant path: `/Users/zieel/Bazil Claude 3/Websites/E- Segar Chicken/assets/img/hero-chicken.webp` (only existing image; regenerate per seed #1 + produce the remaining set from §7 seeds).
